blockingIssues.description: The new guard rail only raises when zero HMMs load overall. Explicit mixed requests still silently skip unsupported pairs instead of raising the promised descriptive error, e.g. `allowed_species=['alpaca']` with `allowed_chain=['H','K']` returns only `alpaca_H`, and `allowed_species=['human','alpaca']` with `allowed_chain=['K']` returns only `human_K`.

nonBlockingIssues.description: `test_cow_hmms_load_successfully()` only proves at least one cow HMM loaded, not that all promised `H/K/L` cow models load.
`test_cow_vh_produces_numbered_result()` checks only `result.shape[1] > 5`, so it does not prove Kabat positions were populated.
`test_chicken_hmms_load_successfully()` only proves at least one chicken HMM loaded and does not directly verify both heavy and lambda support.
`test_chicken_vh_produces_numbered_result()` checks only `result.shape[1] > 5`, so it does not prove numbered residue positions were populated.
The new guard-rail tests do not cover mixed explicit requests like `['alpaca'] x ['H','K']` or `['human','alpaca'] x ['K']`, so the narrowed implementation gap remained untested.

appliedUpdates.description: Added `.factory/services.yaml` command `test_unit_renumbering_fast` so workers have a repo-sanctioned scoped renumbering regression command that skips the known pre-existing `test_renumbering.py` failures.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the validation procedure to prefer repo-provided scoped validator commands over unconditional full-suite `pytest` runs when mission guidance documents practical timeouts or known exclusions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: All three species-expansion reviews, this scrutiny run, and the workers' transcripts show broader `pytest` runs timing out before falling back to scoped renumbering validation, while `AGENTS.md` explicitly allows targeted alternatives for this repo.
